hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: Launchpad hook that captures the full trading fee via before/afterSwap deltas (denominated in the quote/WETH currency) across three phases: a guard phase with exponentially decaying fees (90%→3%) and per-wallet/per-block buy caps, a bonding-curve phase (1% flat fee), and a graduated phase (1% flat fee). Fees are distributed through an attached FeeRouter with optional referrer attribution via hookData.
